title: Application Monitoring Node Exporter Entity
description: Prometheus node_exporter configuration. Extends Application/Monitoring with node_exporter-specific settings.

collectors.description: Enabled collectors (e.g., cpu, diskstats, filesystem, meminfo, netdev, loadavg).

web_config.description: TLS and basic authentication configuration for the metrics endpoint.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file.

basic_auth_users.description: Basic auth users (username to bcrypt-hashed password).

textfile_directory.description: Directory for the textfile collector to read .prom files from.
